## ENTERIC FEVER (INCLUDING TYPHOID AND PARATYPHOID FEVER)
Enteric fever is a systemic febrile illness caused by Salmonella enterica
serotypes Typhi and Paratyphi A, B, or C.
## Primary treatment
Hydration and electrolyte replacement
## Antimicrobial Treatment
## Inpatient Consult Infectious Diseases for duration of therapy
